q: How many plants have greenhouse gas intensity targets under India's CCTS?
title: How many plants have CCTS targets
short: 488 plants have notified targets: 280 under the October 2025 rules (aluminium, cement, chlor-alkali, pulp and paper) and 208 added in January 2026 (secondary aluminium, refineries, petrochemicals, textiles). A June 2026 draft proposes 255 iron and steel plants on top.
audience: Plant heads, ESG teams and suppliers to large industry

ul: G.S.R. 739(E), 8 October 2025: aluminium 13, cement 186, chlor-alkali 30, pulp and paper 51. Total 280.
G.S.R. 25(E), 13 January 2026: secondary aluminium 3, petroleum refineries 21, petrochemical crackers 11, textiles 173. Total 208.

G.S.R. 517(E), published 26 June 2026 as a draft for 60 days of comments: 255 iron and steel plants, with targets for 2026-27 only. Check whether final rules have followed before you rely on these figures.

p: Each plant has a registration number in the schedules (for example ALMOE001OD for the first aluminium plant). The totals here are unique registration numbers in each gazette notification. Every target uses 2023-24 as the baseline year.

senseible: Senseible reads invoices for plants and their suppliers; it is not part of the CCTS process.

reviewNote: Counts are unique registration numbers in the English schedules of G.S.R. 739(E) and G.S.R. 25(E), and of the G.S.R. 517(E) draft, read on 23 October 2026.
